state: frozen before outcome evaluation; research only

rules.volatility: mean true range of 14 already closed 5-second quote bars
rules.minorPivot: strict high/low of already closed one-second observed closing quotes, two points each side
rules.entry: reversal confirmed and price beyond an already confirmed opposite minor pivot within the same swing and preceding the extreme, last quote not moving against the chosen side
rules.source: received positive unique quotes; maximum gap 3500 ms; no interpolation
rules.signal: one immutable signal per pivot; use current observed price and decision time
rules.overlap: events during an active 30s operation are consumed, never queued for late entry

acceptance.completeExternalCohorts: higher win rate than current base, positive illustrative net at 86% payout, at least 25% of base completed entry count, no worse maximum per-window loss streak
acceptance.native: separate exploratory results; no profitability or independent validation claim from OCR or small memory captures
acceptance.holdout: only evaluate a new holdout after complete development cohorts pass

limits: No signal is plotted or scored at an earlier pivot timestamp.
No threshold grid or tuning after inspecting outcomes.
Historical Forex and crypto are not IQ Option/Exnova OTC.
No bot, broker I/O, production code, or database changes.
